text:
toni: Heads-up: after upgrading the JS SDK to 1.8.0 our Next edge sample started throwing "ReferenceError: process is not defined" in the worker and bundle size jumped ~170KB.

rachel: yikes. which import line?

toni: `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` inside middleware.ts. bundle analyzer shows a CJS wrapper and node shims (process, Buffer, crypto) plus lodash chunks.

eng-qa: Common cause: root index file re-exports the CJS build (`module.exports = require('./dist/index.cjs.js')`) which makes bundlers treat it as CommonJS and prevents tree-shaking.

toni: checked package.json inside node_modules: has "main" and "module" fields but no "exports" and no "sideEffects". publishing tarball also contains dist/*.cjs, dist/*.esm, and a root index.js shim.

rachel: short-term workarounds for apps: 1) explicitly import the ESM build `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js'` 2) dynamic import inside the edge handler 3) pin to 1.7.x. all are friction.

dev-bot: :warning: ci/bundle-regression detected for /edge-sample (delta +170KB) - artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/bundle-1769999999.html

eng-qa: long-term SDK fixes: - add conditional exports in package.json so `import` resolves to ESM and `require` resolves to CJS - set "sideEffects": false (with explicit file exceptions if needed) - move any top-level `require('node:crypto')` or other node-only requires into lazy runtime code paths - shrink published tarball (strip maps/dev-only files) - add bundler smoke tests (esbuild/webpack/rollup) that run in CI against the packed tarball.

toni: typings note: TS users sometimes rely on default import shape. when changing exports map ensure "types" points to dist/index.d.ts and that default vs named exports are represented in the .d.ts to avoid forcing consumers to enable esModuleInterop.

rachel: also add a short docs blurb under devex about worker/edge bundler gotchas and recommended import lines until we ship a fix. include an explicit Next middleware snippet.

dev-bot: :white_check_mark: created issue #500 with bundle analyzer, repro steps, and suggested patch. assigned to @sdk-team and milestone 1.8.1.

eng-qa: test plan for the fix: 1) publish a beta with exports map + sideEffects false, 2) run app reproduction against beta, 3) run CI smoke tests bundling with esbuild/webpack targeting edge/browser, 4) assert bundle diff <50KB and no process/Buffer strings in bundle.

toni: I'll add a temporary changelog line telling edge/deno/worker users to import from the explicit ESM path until the patch lands to reduce support load.

rachel: I can help with the EE test matrix and run local rollup/webpack checks. ping me on the PR.

docs: drafting the docs PR with sample snippet and a short checklist for SDK maintainers (exports map, sideEffects, lazy requires, publish tarball sanity).

dev-bot: :memo: link to CI repro artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/bundle-1769999999.html - keep this thread for follow-ups.
